SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   C. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

5. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
